Select IC50 activities for JAK2 with publication provenance. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target name JAK2 and standard_type IC50. Include compound_structures via INNER JOIN for canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
